summary: Comprehensive testing of Multi-Tenant Property & Hospitality Management SaaS completed. All core features working correctly including landing page, authentication, CRUD operations, dashboard KPIs, and subscription management.

minor_issues.issue: POST endpoints return 200 instead of 201 status code
minor_issues.impact: Minor - functionality works correctly but HTTP status codes don't follow REST conventions

passed_tests: Landing page loads with hero section, CTAs, and features
Subscription plans API returns correct data
Auth-gated pages work with valid session cookies
Properties CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete)
Staff CRUD operations with salary and assignment management
Expenses CRUD with fixed/variable categorization and filtering
Bookings CRUD with property assignments and status management
Invitations creation and validation with role-based access
Dashboard KPI cards display correctly with real-time data
Navigation between all pages (Properties, Staff, Expenses, Bookings, Invitations, Billing, Settings)
Company setup dialog appears for users without company
Admin-only features restricted properly based on role
Billing page shows subscription plans with proper pricing
Settings page displays user and company information
Seed demo data endpoint creates sample data successfully

success_percentage.backend: 98% (34/35 tests passed - minor HTTP status code issue)
success_percentage.integration: 100% (All auth, CRUD, and navigation flows working)
